gamerule.stratosDrivingSide.description: Which side new roads keep to. Roads already placed keep their own side.
key.stratos.tool: Take the Stratos tool out / put it away
key.stratos.undo: Undo the last Stratos edit (tool in hand)
key.stratos.redo: Redo the last undone Stratos edit (tool in hand)
key.stratos.raise: Raise the road's end (tool in hand)
key.stratos.lower: Lower the road's end (tool in hand)
key.stratos.shape: Switch the road's vertical shape (tool in hand)
key.stratos.radius_type: Type the vertical radius (tool in hand)
key.stratos.crossings: Switch the road's pedestrian crossing on or off (tool in hand)
key.stratos.nodes: Switch the road's node aid: blue wool, MTR nodes or none (tool in hand)
stratos.hub.title: Stratos hub
stratos.hub.palette_tip: The blocks new roads are built from.
stratos.hub.palette_own: Your own palettes go in config/stratos/palettes.
stratos.hub.nodes_tip: What marks each lane's centre on a new road.
stratos.hub.nodes_key: %s steps through them with a road tool in hand.
stratos.hub.nodes.track_unavailable: This server can't build hidden MTR track.
stratos.hub.nodes.mtr_unavailable: MTR nodes need MTR in the game.
stratos.hub.world.warning: Roads here use Stratos blocks. Bake them to vanilla before you remove Stratos, or their surfaces are lost.
stratos.hub.world.bake_tip: Turns every Stratos block in the world into the nearest vanilla block.
stratos.hub.world.redraw_tip: Rebuilds the painted lines of your roads with today's rules.
stratos.hub.world.bake_confirm: Every Stratos block in every dimension becomes the nearest vanilla block, so the world no longer needs Stratos. Undo puts them back while Stratos is installed. New roads still use the palette chosen in the hub.
stratos.hub.world.redraw_confirm: Each of your roads with painted lines is rebuilt from its record with today's rules, keeping blocks you changed by hand. Each road is its own undo step.
stratos.hub.world.drive_right_tip: Traffic here keeps left. This makes the world keep right and rebuilds your roads and junctions for it: lanes, hidden track and give-way lines. Roads you draw from now on keep right.
stratos.hub.world.drive_left_tip: Traffic here keeps right. This makes the world keep left and rebuilds your roads and junctions for it: lanes, hidden track and give-way lines. Roads you draw from now on keep left.
stratos.hub.world.drive_right_confirm: The world will keep right. Each of your roads and junctions is rebuilt for right-hand traffic, junctions first, each as its own undo step; a road that changes no block has nothing to undo. Roads of other players stay on the left until they do the same.
stratos.hub.world.drive_left_confirm: The world will keep left. Each of your roads and junctions is rebuilt for left-hand traffic, junctions first, each as its own undo step; a road that changes no block has nothing to undo. Roads of other players stay on the right until they do the same.
stratos.hub.settings.faces_tip: Outlines only leaves the faces out, for a shader pack that shows them badly.
stratos.hub.settings.shader_faces_tip: Stratos draws the faces two ways, so every shader pack shows them.
stratos.hub.settings.shader_faces.no_pac: No shader pack in use now.
stratos.hub.settings.shader_faces.auto_t: Once with BSL and Bliss, twice with any other pack.
stratos.hub.settings.shader_faces.both_t: Always both draws. Every pack shows the faces.
stratos.hub.settings.shader_faces.one_ti: Always one draw. A pack that doesn't show it shows no faces.
stratos.hub.settings.shader_faces_note: BSL and Bliss show both draws, so their faces look more solid; Auto draws them once there. Both and One are for packs Auto doesn't know.
stratos.hub.settings.draw_time_tip: How long the preview takes to draw, per frame, averaged over 120 frames.
stratos.hub.settings.reset_all_tip: Puts every setting on this page back as it was at first.
stratos.tool.state.check_place: Check the road, then place it
stratos.tool.state.pick_start_facing: Face along it, pick the start
stratos.tool.state.aim_end_facing: Face along it, aim at the end
stratos.tool.line.heading: Heading
stratos.tool.value.heading: %s · %s°
stratos.radius.title: Vertical radius
stratos.radius.help: Two radii's radius in blocks, %s to %s. Type the same number into MTR's rail screen for hidden track.
stratos.tool.state.aim_junction: Aim at a road end or the ground
stratos.edit.state.aim: Aim at one of your roads
stratos.edit.state.editing: Move an end, or use the toolbar
stratos.edit.question.what: %s blocks long. Edit its ends or layout, rebuild it as Stratos builds it today, or delete it and put back what was there before?
stratos.edit.question.what_bake: %s blocks long. Edit its ends or layout, rebuild it as Stratos builds it today, bake its Stratos blocks to vanilla ones, or delete it and put back what was there before?
stratos.edit.question.edits_rebuild: %s blocks of this road were changed by hand since Stratos placed it. Overwrite them, or keep them as they are and rebuild the rest?
stratos.edit.question.edits_delete: %s blocks of this road were changed by hand since Stratos placed it. Overwrite them too, or keep them as they are and delete the rest?
stratos.edit.question.edits_edit: %s blocks of this road were changed by hand since Stratos placed it. Overwrite them, or keep them as they are and edit the rest?
stratos.edit.choice.edit.tip: Move its ends, or change its layout, palette or node aid.
stratos.edit.choice.rebuild.tip: Build it again as Stratos builds roads today, keeping its palette.
stratos.edit.choice.rebuild_in.tip: Build it again in %s, the palette you have chosen.
stratos.edit.choice.rebuild_in.vanilla.t: Build it again in Vanilla, the palette you have chosen.
stratos.edit.choice.rebuild_in.stratos_u: Build it again in Stratos UK, the palette you have chosen.
stratos.edit.choice.delete.tip: Take it away and put back what was there before.
stratos.edit.choice.bake.tip: Turn its Stratos blocks into the nearest vanilla blocks. Undo puts them back.
stratos.edit.notice.nothing_to_rebuild: Nothing to rebuild: the road is as Stratos built it.
stratos.edit.notice.nothing_to_delete: Nothing to delete: you kept every block of this road.
stratos.edit.notice.track_repaired: Its blocks are as Stratos built them; the hidden track of %s lanes was made again.
stratos.edit.notice.nothing_to_edit: Nothing to change: the road is already like this.
stratos.edit.notice.baked: Baked to vanilla: %s blocks. Undo puts them back.
stratos.edit.notice.nothing_to_bake: Nothing to bake: the road has no Stratos blocks left.
stratos.nodes.title: Lane nodes
stratos.nodes.state.no_roads: Place a road with blue wool first
stratos.nodes.state.go_near: Go near a road you placed
stratos.task.progress.finding: Looking for Stratos blocks: %s of %s chunks read
stratos.task.progress.baking: Baking to vanilla: %s of %s sections done
stratos.task.bake_world.done: Baked %s Stratos blocks to vanilla. Undo puts them back.
stratos.task.bake_world.done_kept: Baked %s Stratos blocks to vanilla; %s that changed meanwhile were left. Undo puts them back.
stratos.task.bake_world.none: This world has no Stratos blocks: there's nothing to bake.
stratos.task.progress.switching: Switching driving side: %s of %s roads done
stratos.task.drive.done_right: The world keeps right now. %s roads and junctions were rebuilt for it.
stratos.task.drive.done_left: The world keeps left now. %s roads and junctions were rebuilt for it.
stratos.task.drive.others: %s roads of other players still keep the old side. The server refuses to edit them until they are switched.
stratos.task.drive.failed: %s roads or junctions couldn't be switched; the server's log says why. Run the switch again once it is fixed.
stratos.task.redraw.done: Redrew the markings of %s roads; %s were already up to date.
stratos.task.redraw.others: %s roads of other players were left as they are.
stratos.task.redraw.failed: %s roads couldn't be redrawn; the server's log says why.
stratos.undo.done_kept: Undone. %s blocks changed by hand since were kept.
stratos.reject.protocol_mismatch: This server runs Stratos %2$s and you have %1$s, so editing is off. Install Stratos %2$s from Modrinth.
stratos.reject.editing_off: Editing is off on this server.
stratos.reject.world_read_only: This world's Stratos data was saved by a newer Stratos, so it's read-only here. Update Stratos to edit it.
stratos.reject.permission_denied: You don't have permission to edit with Stratos here (%s).
stratos.reject.busy: Your last Stratos edit is still being worked out or placed. Try again when it has finished.
stratos.reject.rate_limited: You're sending Stratos edits too quickly. Wait a moment and try again.
stratos.reject.volume_limit: This edit changes %s blocks; your limit is %s.
stratos.reject.volume_per_minute: You've changed %s blocks in the last minute; your limit is %s a minute. Try again in %s s.
stratos.reject.plan_hash_mismatch: The server worked out a different result, so nothing was changed.
stratos.reject.plan_hash_mismatch_refres: The server worked out a different result, so nothing was changed. The preview has been refreshed.
stratos.reject.plan_too_complex: This edit took longer than %s seconds to work out, so nothing was changed. Try a smaller one.
stratos.reject.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server, so nothing was changed. Please report it.
stratos.reject.find_failed: Stratos couldn't read the world to look for its blocks, so nothing more was changed. The server's log says why.
stratos.reject.undo_data_unreadable: The undo data couldn't be read, so nothing was changed.
stratos.reject.undo_not_recorded: The edit was made, but its undo history couldn't be updated, so it may not undo cleanly. Please report it.
stratos.reject.redo_conflict: Some blocks changed since the undo, so the redo was cancelled and nothing was changed.
stratos.reject.block_entity: Another mod's block with stored contents is in the way, so nothing was changed.
stratos.reject.block_entity_appeared: Another mod's block with stored contents appeared while placing. What was placed so far can be undone.
stratos.reject.conflict: Some blocks changed while placing. What was placed so far can be undone.
stratos.reject.stopped: The server stopped before the edit finished. What was placed so far can be undone.
stratos.reject.data_version: Internal error: this edit was made for another Minecraft version. Please report it.
stratos.reject.invalid_state: Internal error: this edit uses a block this game doesn't have. Please report it.
stratos.reject.track_unavailable: This server can't build hidden MTR track, so nothing was changed. Choose another node aid.
stratos.reject.repairing: Stratos is repairing this world after a crash. Try again in a few seconds.
stratos.reject.journal_failed: Stratos couldn't write its crash journal (is the disk full?), so the edit stopped. What was placed so far can be undone.
stratos.reject.manual_edits: %s blocks of this road were changed by hand.
stratos.reject.nothing_to_change: Nothing to change: the road is already as it would be.
stratos.reject.driving_side_mismatch: This world's traffic keeps %s, but this road is for the other side, so nothing was changed. If the world just switched sides, wait for its roads to be switched, then try again.
stratos.reject.not_your_road: This is another player's road. Editing other players' roads comes later.
stratos.notice.track_not_built: The road is placed, but %1$s of its %2$s lanes got no hidden track. The log says why.
stratos.notice.track_not_removed: Undone, but the hidden track of %1$s of %2$s lanes couldn't be removed, so it is still there. The log says why.
stratos.notice.repaired: Stratos repaired this world after a crash. Edits rolled back: %1$s. Edits completed: %2$s.
stratos.notice.repaired_attention: Stratos repaired this world after a crash. Edits rolled back: %1$s. Edits completed: %2$s. Not fully repaired: %3$s (the log says what).
stratos.road.reject.lane_ends_staggered: This bend is too sharp so near its end for the lanes to end together. Make it gentler or longer.
stratos.road.reject.world_limit: Part of the road is outside the world's build limits.
stratos.road.reject.end_not_in_line: The end isn't straight ahead of the start. Move the end onto the start's direction, or give both ends the same direction.
stratos.road.reject.no_mtr_path: MTR can't join these points with these headings. Move an end or change a heading.
stratos.road.reject.parallel_beside: The end is beside the start, so MTR can't make this bend. Move the end further along.
stratos.road.reject.reverse_heading: This would turn the road back on itself.
stratos.road.reject.lane_solve_failed: Lane %s can't follow this curve with MTR. Try a gentler curve.
stratos.road.reject.s_curve_too_sharp: This S-bend turns %s° (max 22.5°). Make it at least %s blocks long.
stratos.road.reject.radius_too_small: Too tight: the inner lane's radius is %s; %s (%s) needs at least %s.
stratos.road.reject.inner_edge_degenerat: This curve is tighter than the road is wide.
stratos.road.reject.lane_spacing: Lanes would squeeze to %s blocks here.
stratos.road.reject.grade_too_steep: Too steep: %s%% (max %s%%). Make it at least %s blocks long or rise less.
stratos.road.reject.cross_lane_step: Lanes would be %s blocks apart in height (max 0.25).
stratos.road.reject.nodes_join_other_way: MTR would join lane %s's nodes the other way round. Split the bend into two shorter pieces.
stratos.road.reject.mtr_missing: MTR isn't installed on this server, so Stratos can't place MTR nodes. Use blue wool markers instead.
stratos.road.reject.road_end_gone: The road this one joins isn't there any more (undone or removed). Set that end again.
stratos.road.reject.road_gone: This road isn't there any more (undone or deleted). Pick another.
stratos.road.reject.road_changed: This road changed since you picked it. Pick it again.
stratos.road.reject.road_joined: This change would pull the road away from a road joined to it, or a road joined to it can't follow it there. Keep its lanes the same, and its joined ends where those roads can reach.
stratos.road.reject.road_too_old: Stratos no longer has what was here before this road (a world keeps the undo data of its last 200 edits), so it can't delete it exactly. Rebuild still works.
stratos.road.reject.port_mismatch: This road doesn't line up with the road end it joins. Set that end again.
stratos.road.reject.side_mismatch: That road keeps to the other side of the road (it was built before the world's driving side changed), so this one can't join it.
stratos.road.reject.profile_mismatch: These roads have different layouts: %s can't join %s, as their lanes don't line up.
stratos.road.reject.unknown_palette: There's no palette called %s here. Choose another one in the hub.
stratos.road.reject.unknown_junction: There is no junction of this kind and size for this road layout. Junctions need one lane each way; pick another layout or size.
stratos.road.reject.grade_on_mixed_piece: This bend climbs unevenly (lanes %s blocks apart in height) and can't be split into a straight and a bend. Climb on a straight road, then join the bend to it.
stratos.road.warn.step_22_5: MTR will draw this as a very slight S-bend (%s blocks off).
stratos.road.warn.tight_for_long_vehicle: Long vehicles may clip the kerb on this curve.
stratos.road.warn.full_block_steps: This palette has no slabs, so the slope will be stepped.
stratos.road.warn.bend_split: Split into a straight and a bend, so the lanes climb evenly.
stratos.road.warn.joined_taper: Joined to your %s: the layout changes here.
stratos.feature.junction_edit: rebuilding or deleting a junction (undo it instead)
stratos.feature.pieces: roads of more than one piece
stratos.feature.world_tasks: baking to vanilla and redrawing markings
stratos.module.roads.description: UK road layouts whose lanes line up with MTR rails, for bus routes.
stratos.module.terrain.description: Brushes for shaping the land around your builds.
stratos.module.forest.description: Trees built from real blocks, spread out naturally.
stratos.module.transit.description: Improvements for MTR, such as longer render distances.
